mapper.select: SELECT /* BoardMapper.isValidCategoryForBoard */ COUNT(1) FROM BOARD_MASTER BM INNER JOIN COMMON_CODE_DETAIL CCD /* inner 는 생략 가능 */ ON BM.GROUP_CODE = CCD.GROUP_CODE WHERE BM.BOARD_CODE = #{boardCode} /* 게시판 확인 */ AND CCD.CODE_ID = #{categoryId} /* 카데고리명 확인 */ AND BM.USE_YN= 'Y' /* 사용중인 게시판인지 확인 */ AND CCD.USE_YN= 'Y' /* 사용중인 카테고리인지 확인 */
SELECT /* BoardMapper.existBoardContent */ COUNT(1) FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND DELETE_YN = 'N'

SELECT /* BoardMapper.getSearchScrapTotalCount 스크랩 페이지 총개수 조회*/ COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_SCRAP BS INNER JOIN BOARD B ON BS.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID WHERE BS.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND B.DELETE_YN = 'N'
AND MATCH (TITLE, CONTENT) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)

SELECT /* BoardMapper.searchScrapMyPage (스크랩된 마이 페이지 조회) */ B.BOARD_ID , B.TITLE , B.CONTENT , B.MEMBER_ID , B.BOARD_CODE , B.CATEGORY_ID , B.VIEW_COUNT , B.LIKE_COUNT , B.CREATE_AT , B.UPDATE_AT , B.TAG_NAME , BS.SCRAP_ID /* 스크랩 고유 ID */ , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_MANAGEMENT CM WHERE CM.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID AND CM.DELETE_YN = 'N') AS commentCount /* 댓글 작성 수 */ FROM BOARD B INNER JOIN BOARD_SCRAP BS ON B.BOARD_ID = BS.BOARD_ID WHERE BS.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND B.DELETE_YN = 'N' /* 검색 키워드가 있을 때만 검색 조건 추가 searchScrapMyPage */
AND MATCH(TITLE, CONTENT) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE)
ORDER BY BS.SCRAP_ID DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset} /* 페이징 처리 추가 */

SELECT /*BoardMapper.getBoardFileInfoByIds (삭제 대상 파일 정보 조회) */ FILE_PATH , SAVE_NAME FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE FILE_ID IN
#{id}
SELECT /* BoardMapper.getBoardFileInfo (첨부파일 다운로드를 위한 파일 정보 조회) */ FILE_PATH , ORIGIN_NAME , SAVE_NAME FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId}
SELECT /* BoardMapper.findById (게시글 1건에 memberId를 조회) */ MEMBER_ID FROM BOARD WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT /* BoardMapper.getPopularBoards (최근 15일 인기 게시글 조회) */ B.BOARD_ID , B.TITLE , B.VIEW_COUNT , B.LIKE_COUNT , B.CREATE_AT , M.USER_NAME , M.PROFILE_IMAGE FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN MEMBER_INFO M ON B.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE B.CREATE_AT >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 15 DAY) AND B.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY B.LIKE_COUNT DESC, B.VIEW_COUNT DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT /* BoardMapper.getRecentFallbackBoards (인기 게시글 없을 시 대체 조회) */ B.BOARD_ID , B.TITLE , B.VIEW_COUNT , B.LIKE_COUNT , B.CREATE_AT , M.USER_NAME , M.PROFILE_IMAGE FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN MEMBER_INFO M ON B.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE B.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY B.LIKE_COUNT DESC, B.VIEW_COUNT DESC, B.CREATE_AT DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT /* BoardMapper.getBoardFileList (게시글에 첨부된 파일 리스트 조회) */ FILE_ID , BOARD_ID , ORIGIN_NAME , SAVE_NAME , FILE_PATH , FILE_SIZE , CREATE_AT FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}

SELECT /* BoardMapper.getSearchBoard (게시판 글 단건조회 (사용자 정보 JOIN)) */ B.BOARD_ID , B.TITLE , B.CONTENT , M.USER_ID , M.USER_NAME , B.MEMBER_ID , B.BOARD_CODE , B.CATEGORY_ID , B.VIEW_COUNT , B.LIKE_COUNT , M.PROFILE_IMAGE , B.CREATE_AT , B.UPDATE_AT , B.TAG_NAME , BS.SCRAP_ID /* 스크랩 고유 ID */ FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN MEMBER_INFO M ON B.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN BOARD_SCRAP BS ON B.BOARD_ID = BS.BOARD_ID AND BS.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} WHERE B.BOARD_ID = #{boardId} AND B.DELETE_YN = 'N'

SELECT /* BoardMapper.getBoardList (게시판 목록 전체를 조회하는 쿼리 (사용자 정보 JOIN))*/ B.BOARD_ID , B.TITLE , B.CONTENT , M.USER_ID , M.USER_NAME , B.MEMBER_ID , B.BOARD_CODE , B.CATEGORY_ID , B.VIEW_COUNT , B.LIKE_COUNT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_MANAGEMENT CM WHERE CM.BOARD_ID = B.BOARD_ID AND CM.DELETE_YN = 'N') AS commentCount /* 댓글 작성 수 */ , M.PROFILE_IMAGE , B.CREATE_AT , B.UPDATE_AT , B.TAG_NAME FROM BOARD B LEFT JOIN MEMBER_INFO M ON B.MEMBER_ID = M.MEMBER_ID WHERE B.DELETE_YN = 'N' ORDER BY B.CREATE_AT DESC
